title: Can a High Court condemn a judge unheard?

scenes.dialogue: When a trial judge's verdict has some typing errors, can a higher court condemn that judge in a judicial order, without first hearing the judge's side?

scenes.dialogue: A district judge in Rajasthan heard two trials from one case: a juvenile tried as an adult, and an adult co-accused. The law required separate judgments.
